Hi Sam — Kim from Redwood security here. Short answers ahead of Wed's orientation:

- Evidence transfer: We can accept SFTP for a one-time bulk upload (preferred), and DocuSign for executed DPA documents. Our security operations team will provide an SFTP dropbox with time-limited credentials; I will share the logistics after the call, or sooner if you prefer.
- Pen test window: late September sounds fine. Please plan for a 48–72 hour ops notification window and share scope (external vs. authenticated) so we can coordinate our incident ops team. There are no standing blackout windows in September currently, but we do ask that high-impact tests be scheduled during our UTC-07:00 working hours where possible to ensure quick ops support.

I've attached a short SOC 2 evidence checklist to help you map documents before the call. Also proposing we reserve a 30-minute technical deep-dive (post-orientation) for the infra/engineering owners; that will let us go through KV cache, data retention defaults, and routing policies.

See you Wed Aug 1 09:00 PST — calendar invite should have the dial-in.

Kimberly Park
Information Security Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf
